behavior.fee_notional_and_basis_points: Checked arithmetic returns explicit errors for invalid inputs, rates, and overflow; built-in fee models validate their parameters.
behavior.backtest_accounting: Single-market and shared-account order-book fee/turnover raw projections reject overflowing totals.
behavior.ashare_corporate_actions: Cash flows, share ratios, rights-issue cash, reference-price division, and tick rounding reject overflow; point and series lookups propagate errors before matching.
behavior.spread_attribution: Leg totals and cost-basis-point scaling reject overflow instead of emitting saturated totals.
source_api_changes: FeeModel::commission and commission_for_side now return QxResult<i128>.

validation.command: cargo check -p qx-core -p qx-xingban -p qx-zhenlu -p qx-app -p contract-tests -j 1

limitations: No full-workspace test or release matrix was run.
No connected exchange, sandbox provider, capacity, or production acceptance was performed.
The Rust trait and A-share query return-type changes require downstream source updates and a compatible version bump before publishing.
